texts.zh:
多亏了我们与[overlord_empire.GetName]的许多交易，我们已经能够集中精力建立和改善帝国的内部工作。在我们的科学家和工程师们的努力工作下，我们看到我们的殖民地在过去几年里蓬勃发展。人们在几年前还以为是幻想的事情，突然之间不仅变成了现实，而且变得司空见惯。

我们收到消息，我们在[overlord_empire.GetName]的长官想亲自看看我们的最新进展，并有可能把其中一些带回他们的祖国。
texts.en:
Thanks to our many deals with [overlord_empire.GetName], we have been able to focus much of our efforts on building and improving the internal workings of our empire. With our scientists and engineers hard at work, we have seen our colonies blossom these last years, as things one would have thought a fantasy only a few years back have suddenly become not only real, but even commonplace.

We have received news that our wardens in [overlord_empire.GetName] would like to see our latest progress in person, and potentially bring some of it back to their homeland.

texts.zh:
多亏了我们与[overlord_empire.GetName]的许多交易，我们已经能够集中精力于帝国的建筑及其改良工作。由于我们预留了很大一部分集体智能用来完成这项任务，以前被认为不可能的技术和工程壮举，现在已经在我们的星球上司空见惯。

我们收到消息，我们在[overlord_empire.GetName]的看守想亲自看看我们的最新进展，并有可能把其中一些带回他们的祖国。
texts.en:
Thanks to our many deals with [overlord_empire.GetName], we have been able to focus much of our efforts on building and improving the structure of our empire. With a significant portion of our intellect reserved for this task, technologies and feats of engineering never thought possible have now become a commonplace on our worlds.

We have received news that our wardens in the [overlord_empire.GetName] would like to see our latest progress in person, and potentially bring some of it back to their homeland.

texts.zh: 当来自[overlord_empire.GetName]的使者即将抵达的时候，我们必须决定与我们的宗主分享最新的设计和创作的意愿程度。如果我们分享的话，肯定会受到称赞，但他们可能会更直接地控制我们今后的努力方向。
texts.en: As the emissary is about to arrive from the [overlord_empire.GetName], we have to decide how willing we are to share our latest designs and creations with our overlord. It would surely be appreciated if we were to do so, but it could be that they will take more direct control of where we will focus our efforts moving forward.

label.zh: 尽管如此，还是和我们的宗主分享吧。
label.en: Share it with our overlord nonetheless.
Keep most of it to ourselves.

texts.zh: 我们收到消息，我们的附庸，[subject_empire.GetName]，最近在改善其殖民地发展方面取得了重大进展。一些设计和创作被带回[overlord_empire.Capital.GetName]，它们的发展前景都不错。如果我们愿意，可以要求他们研究一个特定的领域，而不是让他们在没有监督的情况下继续他们努力。
texts.en: We have received news that our vassals, the [subject_empire.GetName], have recently made significant steps in improving the development of their colonies. Several designs and creations have been brought back to [overlord_empire.Capital.GetName], and they are all quite promising. If we wish, we could ask them to look into a specific field, rather than letting them continue their efforts unsupervised.

label.zh: 他们自己显然研究得很好。
label.en: They are clearly doing well on their own already.

label.zh: 让他们把精力集中在物理学上。
label.en: Have them focus their efforts on science.

label.zh: 他们将开展对其社会的社会学研究。
label.en: They will look into the sociological aspects of their society.

label.zh: 工程学——将是他们研究的重点。
label.en: Engineering - that will be their focus.

texts.zh: 似乎我们的[overlord_empire.GetAdj]宗主对之赞赏有加，并且继续允许我们自由行事，而不加干涉或采取控制手段。
texts.en: It seems our [overlord_empire.GetAdj] overlord is appreciative, and will continue to let us do as we wish, without stepping in or trying to take control.

label.en: We will continue our efforts then.

texts.zh: 在看到了我们最近的设计和创造之后，宗主向我们发布了一条指令。因为看到了这些设计创造之中蕴含着的巨大潜力，似乎他们希望我们从今往后开始聚焦于物理学研究。
texts.en: We have received a directive from our overlord, after they saw our designs and latest creations. It seems they want us to focus our efforts on the sciences from now on, as they think those designs and creations have the most potential.

texts.zh: 在看到了我们最近的设计和创造之后，宗主向我们发布了一条指令。因为看到了这些设计和理念之中蕴含着的巨大潜力，似乎他们希望我们从今往后开始聚焦于社会学研究。
texts.en: We have received a directive from our overlord, after they saw our designs and latest creations. It seems they want us to focus our efforts on the social sciences from now on, as they think those designs and ideas have the most potential.

texts.zh: 在看到了我们最近的设计和创造之后，宗主向我们发布了一条指令。因为看到了这些设计和改进之中蕴含着的巨大潜力，似乎他们希望我们从今往后开始聚焦于工程学研究。
texts.en: We have received a directive from our overlord, after they saw our designs and latest creations. It seems they want us to focus our efforts on engineering from now on, as they think those designs and improvements have the most potential.
